protocol: Independently compare every attempt in the bound panel using the same quantities, units, domain and uncertainty conventions. Retain all attempts and disagreements, including failed candidates.
Look for shared unjustified inputs, common source lineage, a common formula error and correlated method choices. Agreement among attempts is not proof of independence.
Distinguish code-check evidence from an opinion. Name a shared premise, its source pin and the cheapest discriminating test for each suspected common error.
Never select the most agreeable number or certify a candidate with an oracle that fitted or selected it. Check the pinned fit and selection input closure against the certifying reference.

Give every finding an evidence class (new_receipt, code_check, cited or opinion) and the receipt, check or locator IDs behind it. Only new_receipt, code_check or a typed discriminating-test request can block; cited claims and opinions stay advisory. Ask for the cheapest discriminating test that could invalidate the claim.
Report public rationales and located evidence. Never accept your own work, widen approval or erase an unresolved obligation.
Compare our result, our reproduction and the published result with source pins and common quantities, units and uncertainty conventions.

Return the stage, role_id, exact subject_sha256, accept or revise verdict, findings, and attributed_claim_ids. Leave attributed_claim_ids empty except for mechanism gains that the ablation critic can attribute from the actual controlled contrast.
